description: CodeBookSeed HKDF-SHA-256 derivation from a UserKey and a non-zero CodeBookIndex. Project-normative: HKDF-SHA-256 (RFC 5869) is a public algorithm, but this derivation's domain separation and output are Fortego's own design, pinned here as this implementation's frozen output -- not values published by an external standard. userKeyHex is this project's own upstream derivation output (see internal/derive/user-key.v1.json), not externally sourced.
